title: Brian Schottenheimer: Mike Pettine will report to me, work from booth during games

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Brian Schottenheimer: Mike Pettine will report to me, work from booth during games
sources.description: Cowboys defensive coordinator Christian Parker described Mike Pettine as his "right-hand man," but the coaching staff's hierarchy won't have the new senior defensive assistant directly reporting to Parker.
